name: io.github.gpambrozio/onshape
description: Drive Onshape CAD from an assistant: documents, part studios, sketching, solid features, assemblies, drawings, measurement and export, with browser sign-in.

environmentVariables.name: ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Onshape API access key. Optional: the server signs in through the browser when this is not set.

environmentVariables.name: ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Onshape API secret key, paired with ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: ONSHAPE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for exported STL/STEP files and renders. Defaults to the working directory.
